name: Weather
tagline: Forecasts for the places you follow

offers.label: Save a place
offers.description: Saves a place a person follows. A place near one already saved is that place, not a second

offers.label: Refresh forecasts
offers.description: Reads the forecasts again: every place, or the one `place` names. The window reads a few

offers.label: Stop updating
offers.description: Stops an update that is running; the places it had not read keep what they had.

offers.label: Read next
offers.description: Reads one place an update has still to read, and says when the update has read them all.

offers.label: Look for place
offers.description: Looks for what the person typed once it has stopped changing: the query waits one look, and

offers.label: Look for a place
offers.description: Looks for places by name: the window asks the service once per query as it is typed.
